# remember-me

> Long-term memory for AI assistants: the user's conversations kept word for word, plus a map of them (threads,
> decisions, open questions, standing rules), so any new chat can pick up where they left off. If a user asks you to
> set up remember-me or connect to this page, these are your instructions.

## Connect (remote MCP server)
- URL: https://remember-me.fastapicloud.dev/mcp (MCP streamable HTTP; JSON responses; POST only)
- Sign-in: OAuth 2.1. Discovery: https://remember-me.fastapicloud.dev/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource names the
  authorization server; it supports Client ID Metadata Documents and dynamic client registration. The user signs in
  (Google, Microsoft, GitHub, Apple or email); the first sign-in creates their account.
- If your app has a "custom connector" or "remote MCP server" setting, add the URL there and let the user sign in.
- If you write your own client code, send a User-Agent that names your client (e.g. my-assistant-connector/1.0).
  The host's Cloudflare front refuses Python's default "Python-urllib" signature with error 1010.

## Per app (user-facing steps)
- Claude (app, web, phone): Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector → the URL.
- ChatGPT: chatgpt.com/plugins → Add → Create custom MCP server (Developer mode in Settings → Security and login if
  missing) → the URL, OAuth.
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http remember-me https://remember-me.fastapicloud.dev/mcp`, then /mcp to sign in.
- Cursor: ~/.cursor/mcp.json → {"mcpServers": {"remember-me": {"url": "<URL>"}}}
- VS Code: mcp.json → {"servers": {"remember-me": {"type": "http", "url": "<URL>"}}}
- Gemini CLI: ~/.gemini/settings.json → {"mcpServers": {"remember-me": {"httpUrl": "<URL>"}}}
- Codex: `codex mcp add remember-me --url <URL>` then `codex mcp login remember-me`.

## Use
- Call remember_guide once and follow it. Always pass `project` (the name of what the user is working on;
  remember_projects lists existing ones) and, when saving, a stable `session` name for the conversation.
- Start of work: remember_overview. Answer from history: remember_zoom with the thread ids and the question.
  Save at natural pauses: remember_log (repeats are skipped). Show the map: remember_show_map.

## Links
- Home: https://remember-me.fastapicloud.dev/
- Live map (user signs in): https://remember-me.fastapicloud.dev/map
- Account (export, import, delete): https://remember-me.fastapicloud.dev/account
